title.full: What the Enhanced Retirement Sum allows

summary.text: The ERS is the most members aged 55 and above can top up their Retirement Accounts to. In 2026, it is $440,800.

details.heading: What the ERS does
details.body: The ERS lets members top up their Retirement Accounts to receive higher monthly payouts in retirement.

details.heading: How the amount changes
details.body: The ERS is not based on your age or the year you turned 55. It increases every 1 January. In 2027, it will be $456,400.

details.heading: How to top up
details.body: You can top up your Retirement Account with cash or your Ordinary Account savings.

example_phrasings: What is the Enhanced Retirement Sum (ERS)?
How much can I top up to my Retirement Account?

sources.page_title: What is the Enhanced Retirement Sum (ERS)?

quotes.text: The Enhanced Retirement Sum (ERS) in 2026 is $440,800. This is the maximum amount that members aged 55 and above can top up their Retirement Accounts (RA) to in 2026.
Topping up your RA allows you to receive higher monthly payouts in retirement.
The ERS amount is not dependent on your age or the year you turn 55 years old. It increases yearly on 1 January.
You can top up your RA with cash or your Ordinary Account (OA) savings.
